newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end erratic trade mixed.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end erratic trade mixed.

text.p: IMM currency futures ended erratic trade mixed, with Swiss francs and marks rising.
"It was busy off and on," said one floor broker. "But closing trade was quiet."
The price boards showed estimated volume in March futures at 22,000 Swiss franc contracts, 23,000 yen, 31,000 marks, 14,000 sterling and 8,500 Canadian dollar.
"I actually think currencies would have been a lot higher if there wasn't so much spreading going on," said the broker.
March yen stayed above $0.008393, about 120.00 spot, a level that some said seemed defended partly by options ploys.
